subject: How to save objects from server.r as .RData?

messages.author: 33899ed1aae53fa6
messages.subject: How to save objects from server.r as .RData?
parts:
Dears!

I have an application that serves a particular purpose. For my personal control, I need to save the objects created in the file "server.r" as .Rdata. How can I do this?

Thank's!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: How to save objects from server.r as .RData?
parts:
I think all you want to do is use save. 
Example:
save(<your object>, file="something.rda")

-Tareef
